The '''Northern Snowdrift Hills''' was the northwestern stretch of the [[Clabburn Tundra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was the site of the [[Big Sink]], [[Watchpoint Hill]], the [[Ice Claw Wampa Den]], and a number of [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] outposts.
